review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (each applies to their context-only variants). Both items correctly labeled and categorized; no substantive metadata changes required.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants) from S3 Chinese writing part. Both items assess paragraph-level writing skills (identifying topic/central sentence and choosing supporting example). Both metadata fields are educationally coherent and appropriately matched; no revisions required.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure rhetorical/expressive skills appropriate for S3 Chinese writing and metadata largely matches the measured skills.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (each with two context-only variants = 4 variants total). Verdicts: 2 PASS, 0 REVISE, 0 ESCALATE. Metadata fields are educationally coherent and match the skills measured.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items (S3 Chinese writing). Both items measure revision/planning skills for exam writing and metadata are appropriate; no substantive changes required.

reviews.reason: The item tests selection of an appropriate word to describe a careful, deliberate attitude — a vocabulary/word-choice skill. The current label and topic '語基與詞語' and module '基礎掌握' accurately describe this skill and difficulty level.

The item requires identification of grammatically correct vs. incorrect sentences (detecting sentence-level errors). The topic '句子結構與語法', label '病句辨識', and module '基礎掌握' accurately reflect the skill measured.

The item asks students to identify the most suitable paragraph topic/central sentence for a prompt, i.e. recognising the main idea/topic sentence and paragraph organisation. The label '段落組織' directly names this skill; the topic '篇章與寫作組織' is an appropriate higher-level category; the module '整合表達' (integrated expression/composition) coherently encompasses this writing skill.

The item requires choosing an example that best supports a given claim, i.e. evaluating relevance of evidence/examples to support a viewpoint. The label '例子支援' accurately names this skill; the topic '篇章與寫作組織' fits as it concerns cohesion and support within a text; the module '理解與應用' correctly frames the comprehension-and-application nature of the task.

The item asks students to identify a simile (比喻). The label '修辭運用' (use of rhetorical devices), topic '修辭與表達', and module '理解與應用' correctly describe identifying a figure of speech and applying knowledge of rhetoric.

The item assesses choosing an appropriate tone/register for a formal suggestion to the principal. The label '語氣選擇', topic '修辭與表達', and module '理解與應用' accurately reflect the pragmatic rhetorical skill being tested.

The item tests students' ability to develop writing content by adding concrete actions, results and reflections. The label '內容發展', topic '寫作發展' and module '整合表達' accurately describe this skill and are educationally coherent.

The item assesses development and support of a viewpoint in an argumentative paragraph (providing reasons, examples, and a wrap-back). The label '觀點深化', topic '觀點發展與論證' and module '整合表達' correctly reflect the skill.

The stem and hint assess the student’s ability to revise a completed composition for relevance and coherence. The label '修訂表達' and topic '修訂與應試' accurately describe this skill. The module '整合表達' is educationally coherent for a writing-focused item about organising and checking expression.

The item targets pre-writing planning and time-allocation strategy for timed compositions. The label '應試策略' and topic '寫作規劃與應試準備' accurately describe the measured skill. The module '整合表達' is an appropriate, coherent grouping for exam-focused writing strategies.
